QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Pia, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p218##k, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p218#, a resident of #m10001000#. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!

0.0: "Since you've become a resident of #m10001000#, it would be a good idea to go greet the people here. As it happens, I've been wondering how #p218# is doing lately, so please go say hello to #p218#.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Yikes! I don't wanna get eaten by a plush suit! Wait, who are you? What? You're a new resident of #m10001000#? Ahaha! That's so awesome! I'm so excited to have a new neighbor!
1.1: I'm #p218#. This park is my absolute favorite place in #m10001000#. If you ever want to hang out with me, you can come here anytime. Well, I look forward to having fun with you!

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
